title: Customer Governance to S/4 Order-to-Cash readiness
purpose: Show one business requirement moving through authority, integration, failure diagnosis, recovery choice and business-state verification without granting an agent autonomous SAP mutation authority.

business_requirement.statement: When a governed customer delivery-control change becomes current in MDG, every in-scope fulfillment system must converge to that authoritative business state before the customer is treated as ready for Order-to-Cash execution.

invariants: The current authoritative source change, not an old successful message, defines the business state to prove.
Source and target identity must be explicitly resolved before cross-system comparison or recovery.
A message is evidence for a change only when causality is explicit; timestamp proximity is not enough.
Historical replay must preserve event-time mapping and identity semantics.
Technical transport success is not equivalent to target business acceptance.
A fresh target observation matching current authority is required before the incident is resolved.
Unsafe recovery shortcuts remain blocked when evidence is incomplete or contradictory.

positive: The current MDG change is causally linked to the current outbound message.
The message target matches the resolved business identity.
Event-time mapping semantics are known and compatible with the recovery path.
Business processing accepts the current change.
A target observation after current processing shows delivery_control=NEW.
negative: An older successful message must not prove the current change.
An unresolved or conflicting identity must prevent target selection and execution.
Mapping drift must prevent blind historical replay.
Technical success with business rejection must not be called resolved.
A stale target snapshot must not prove the current business postcondition.
A target value mismatch must remain unresolved even when transport was successful.

ownership.business: defines the customer readiness condition and approves business correction
ownership.data_governance: owns authoritative customer state and identity governance
ownership.integration: owns message causality, mapping version and delivery semantics
ownership.operations: collects evidence, runs diagnosis and coordinates bounded recovery
ownership.agent: may read evidence and recommend; may not silently mutate SAP state

cutover_variant.freeze: Authority writes are frozen or explicitly bounded before final delta processing.
cutover_variant.delta_watermark: The final accepted source change/event boundary is recorded explicitly.
cutover_variant.in_flight_messages: Messages crossing the freeze boundary are reconciled by business identity and change identity.
cutover_variant.mapping_version: The mapping/identity version applicable at the event boundary is retained.
cutover_variant.reconciliation: Cutover readiness requires target business-state evidence, not only technical queue completion.

monitor: authoritative changes without causally linked outbound events
operations_handover.resolved_when: Target BP-501 contains delivery_control=NEW and the observed target state is causally traceable to the current MDG change CHG-200.
